glosses: party (person, company, or institution) participating in a legal action or contract

examples.en: Which party do you belong to?
Which party do you belong to?

examples.text: Das Urteil wird beiden Parteien sehr gerecht.
examples.en: The judgement is very fair to both parties.

examples.text: Sie haben die ungeteilte Unterstützung unserer Partei.
examples.en: You have our party's undivided support.
